**Data scientist focused on fraud, risk and credit analytics.** I build models in Python, SQL and PySpark and turn them into decisions: where to set a fraud cutoff, which borrowers need outreach, what a false alarm actually costs.

- **Fraud:** a LightGBM model on 98K card transactions that catches 77% of out-of-time fraud at an 8% review rate, with a cutoff chosen against false-positive costs ([case study](projects/featured/card-fraud/index.qmd))
- **Credit risk:** a Propensity-to-Pay model for BriteCap Financial built on 24M+ bank transactions
- **Data engineering:** PySpark ETL on HDFS and AWS EMR over 18.5M records

MS Business Analytics, UC San Diego (Dec 2025).
